first_public_date_evidence: Bibliographic registry lists September 1, 1963 for Erdős–Rényi, Asymmetric graphs; 1963 original article examined on pp. 312–313. Earlier nonpublic receipt (July 1962) is not treated as publication.
integrity: Self-contained analytic proof; exhaustive independent Prüfer-decoding tests of n=4..8 support but do not certify the infinite theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unrooted labeled trees, integer n>=4, unordered pairs of leaves sharing a neighbor, without a degree-three restriction. Palm size bias by C is not conditioning on C>0. Classical expectation of C is not claimed as new. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is uncertain.
title: Leaf-sibling Palm dominance in uniform labeled trees
